title: E0002: Empty catch
plain_english: A `catch` block should not be left empty. Caught exceptions should be handled, logged, or rethrown.
why_matters: Catching an exception and doing nothing with it hides failures such as bugs, failed database queries, or invalid input. When something goes wrong, the application may fail silently or behave unpredictably without leaving useful trace information.
what_it_checks: `try...catch` blocks where the catch body contains no statements.
